question: How does wearing the yoga-belt reveal the wondrous sovereignty of the queen of yoga lords?
premises: She has become one who wears the yoga-belt.
This state is described as wondrous.
She is the sovereign of the lords of yoga.
inference: Her assumption of the yoga-belt manifests her wondrous supremacy over the lords of yoga.
uncertainties: Whether yogapaṭṭa refers to a literal belt or a symbolic yogic mark is not specified.
plain_english: Having become one who wears the yoga-belt, she is wondrously the sovereign queen of the lords of yoga.
